name: lp
description: Plataforma de geração automática de Landing Pages para empresas a partir de uma URL

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace apps/api & npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/api && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace apps/api && npm run test:coverage --workspace apps/web
